title: Appointed as Assistant
original: There are no evil spirits around you, so can I go now?

title: Talk 1
original: Memories are the vessels of fate, and your fate once came to an abrupt end. That's why the spirits have stopped haunting you, for now. But I can still see their traces, very clearly... Doctor, you should take me seriously... For your own good.

title: Talk 2
original: You can talk to Morte about your troubles. It's okay, Morte will help. Once you fall asleep, all your problems will be solved.

title: Talk 3
original: The feelings that make people cry are just food for Morte, so I don't cry much. Is that a bad thing?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: The true face of the curse? You want to see what's inside Morte's tummy? No... at least not now... That would hurt Morte too. Right. Anyone who hurts Morte will writhe in pain. For real.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: The checklist is still missing a few items: balls of yarn, used buttons, fresh apples, soil from Laterano, crushed CRTs... Doctor, help me.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Here, this apple's for you. It's just a leftover reagent, and I don't like letting things go to waste... Why are you thanking me? I just said it wasn't specifically for you... Hey, why are you patting my head, stop it... Fine.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Because I have Morte, I don't need emotions. But when people tell me I'm doing good, I feel strange inside... And Morte doesn't want to take those emotions away, which makes me...feel off... It's totally normal? Really? In that case... I guess it's fine.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, here. This is Morte's puppet, make sure to keep it with you at all times... A curse? N-No, Doctor... If you take it, it'll be like I'm always by your side... You can't?

title: Idle
original: Sweet slumber~♪ Sweet slumber~♪ Be devoured by your dreams~♪

title: Onboard
original: My new name is Shamare... and this is Morte... As for the other things... it's best you don't find out. Like Morte said, it's for everyone's sake…

title: Watching Battle Record
original: These things won't help with the ritual…

title: Promotion 1
original: Stuff the cotton, sew the mouth shut, plug the ears, and cover the eyes...There, a new doll is done.

title: Promotion 2
original: Morte doesn't need a ritual like this, but…I… I'm happy. We'll both do our best.

title: Added to Squad
original: Work? Got it.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: If only they could be as well-behaved as Morte, that'd be nice.

title: Depart
original: Morte, it's time to go.

title: Begin Operation
original: Today's fortune is… Oh, that's really bad news for you guys.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: What's up?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Everyone's ready.

title: Deployment 1
original: It's time to play, Morte.

title: Deployment 2
original: Your hate, I'll take it all.

title: In Battle 1
original: Go forth, Morte.

title: In Battle 2
original: Rest in peace, and let the land embrace all.

title: In Battle 3
original: Who is it?

title: In Battle 4
original: You won't be going home.

title: 4-star Result
original: The evil spirits, they're all gone now.

title: 3-star Result
original: A predestined victory, just as they whispered.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Some may have gotten away, but it doesn't matter. Morte has already sealed their fates.

title: Operation Failure
original: Curse... you...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: This place... reeks of evil spirits... Not bad.

title: Tap
original: What is it?

title: Trust Tap
original: Join in my needlework? Okay. Morte's also very happy…

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Doctor, I saw you leave the office. There's a lot of people outside today... New Year's? It's so noisy, what are they all doing? Morte doesn't like these holidays. Could you make a talisman with me? If you put an apple stem inside, it'll help you avoid curses.

title: Greeting
original: Hello, Doctor, and, uh...

title: Birthday
original: Give me your hand. Place your fingers here, and make a sign like this… Got it, Doctor? This is a curse. When someone's mean to you, you can fill their whole body with pain. Me? Mm, I don't abuse it, I'm just teaching it to you.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Fur, shiny pebbles, candies, spices, and most importantly, drawing on a smile… Doctor, this is a new doll-making method I've learned. Cute, isn't it? Uhm…
